newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton trade shut for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton trade shut for Hindu festival.

text.p: India's cotton trade was shut on Thursday for a Hindu festival, dealers said. Markets reopen on Friday.

On Wednesday, prices fell on low mill demand and surplus stocks, dealers said. They said state firms were unloading stocks ahead of the new crop season. In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan fell by 100/400 rupees to 13,200/13,600 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while wagad cotton eased by 200 rupees to 11,500 rupees.
